 # Changelog
 
+## Unreleased
+
+The standing time, which was a figure somebody typed in and is now
+arithmetic.
+
+- `cycle` — `decking` works the standing time out of the landing instead
+  of taking it on trust: so many seconds a tub, so many tubs a deck, and
+  a creep at the deck pitch with the keps set again between one deck and
+  the next. A skip takes its discharge however deep the shaft is, a
+  counterweight stands for no time at all, and the two landings are
+  worked at once, so the winder waits for the slower of them and not for
+  the sum of the two.
+- `cycle` — the decked cage, tared at the cage ratio on the coal it
+  holds and filled to what a rope allowance leaves when the rope will
+  not carry the lot; and the sheet that says which of the six deckings
+  raises the most coal, which is fewer decks than will fit as soon as
+  the rope is the limit.
+- `cli` — `sheave decking`, taking `--depth`, `--decks` and `--allowed`.
+
 ## 0.1.0
 
 The first of it: the rope, the machine that drives it, and the colliery

@@ -0,0 +1,146 @@
+/**
+ * `sheave decking` — the standing time, worked out rather than typed in.
+ *
+ * The cycle command takes the standing time as a figure. This one asks
+ * where the figure comes from: so many seconds a tub, so many tubs a
+ * deck, and a creep between decks at whatever the winder is allowed to
+ * inch at. In a shallow shaft it is the largest item in the cycle, and
+ * it comes off a landing and not out of an engine house.
+ *
+ * The sheet at the bottom is the argument a colliery actually has. A
+ * deck added to a cage brings its coal, its own standing time and — at
+ * the cage ratio — twice its coal in steel, so the decks that raise the
+ * most coal are fewer than the decks that will fit.
+ */
+
+import type { Args } from "../args.ts";
+import { flag, number, onlyKnown, option, quantity } from "../args.ts";
+import { cycleTime, profile, windsAnHour } from "../../cycle/kinematics.ts";
+import {
+  MOST_DECKS,
+  bestDecks,
+  deckChange,
+  deckMove,
+  deckPayload,
+  deckSheet,
+  deckedCage,
+  decking,
+  decksAllowed,
+  describeDecking,
+  raises,
+  raisesADay,
+  redecking,
+  stand,
+  standAt,
+  standingADay,
+  standingShare,
+  withDecking,
+  worthOfADeck,
+} from "../../cycle/decking.ts";
+import { A_TUB, gross, loadedWeight, skip } from "../../cage/conveyance.ts";
+import { force, heading, line, metres, perDay, perHour, places, seconds, share, signed, tonnes } from "../../report/format.ts";
+import { barOf, left, right, table } from "../../report/table.ts";
+
+const KNOWN = [
+  "depth",
+  "decks",
+  "allowed",
+  "pertub",
+  "tubsadeck",
+  "pitch",
+  "settle",
+  "discharge",
+  "tub",
+  "full",
+  "creep",
+  "hours",
+  "most",
+  "bars",
+];
+
+/** Run it. */
+export function deckingCommand(args: Args): string[] {
+  onlyKnown(args, KNOWN);
+  const one = decking({
+    perTub: option(args, "pertub") === undefined ? 6 : quantity(args, "pertub"),
+    tubsADeck: number(args, "tubsadeck", 2),
+    pitch: option(args, "pitch") === undefined ? 2.4 : quantity(args, "pitch"),
+    settle: option(args, "settle") === undefined ? 4 : quantity(args, "settle"),
+    discharge: option(args, "discharge") === undefined ? 12 : quantity(args, "discharge"),
+  });
+  const how = profile({
+    full: option(args, "full") === undefined ? 15 : quantity(args, "full"),
+    creep: option(args, "creep") === undefined ? 0.5 : quantity(args, "creep"),
+  });
+  const depth = option(args, "depth") === undefined ? 300 : quantity(args, "depth");
+  const decks = number(args, "decks", 2);
+  const allowed = option(args, "allowed") === undefined ? undefined : quantity(args, "allowed");
+  const aTub = option(args, "tub") === undefined ? A_TUB : quantity(args, "tub");
+  const hours = number(args, "hours", 16);
+  const most = number(args, "most", MOST_DECKS);
+
+  const cage = deckedCage(one, decks, allowed, aTub);
+  const worked = withDecking(how, one, cage, cage);
+
+  const rows: Array<readonly [string, string]> = [
+    ["the wind", metres(depth)],
+    ["tubs a deck", places(one.tubsADeck, 0)],
+    ["a tub takes", seconds(one.perTub)],
+    ["so a deck takes", seconds(deckChange(one))],
+    ["the decks are apart", metres(one.pitch, 2)],
+    ["crept at", `${places(how.creep, 2)} m/s`],
+    ["and the keps take", seconds(one.settle)],
+    ["so a deck move takes", seconds(deckMove(one, how.creep))],
+    ["decks on the cage", places(cage.decks, 0)],
+    ["the moves between them", seconds(redecking(one, cage.decks, how.creep))],
+    ["the cage stands", seconds(standAt(one, cage, how.creep))],
+    ["a skip would stand", seconds(standAt(one, skip(), how.creep))],
+    ["both landings at once", seconds(stand(one, cage, cage, how.creep))],
+  ];
+
+  const bar = (value: number): string => (flag(args, "bars") ? ` ${barOf(value, 20)}` : "");
+
+  const out: string[] = [
+    ...heading(describeDecking(one, how.creep)),
+    ...table([left(""), right("")], rows.map((each) => [each[0], each[1]])),
+    "",
+    ...heading("what that does to the cycle"),
+    ...table(
+      [left(""), right(""), left("")],
+      [
+        ["the cage carries", tonnes(cage.payload), ""],
+        ["and weighs, loaded", force(loadedWeight(cage)), ""],
+        ["gross", tonnes(gross(cage)), ""],
+        ["the standing time is", seconds(worked.rest), bar(standingShare(how, one, cage, cage, depth))],
+        ["the cycle lasts", seconds(cycleTime(worked, depth)), ""],
+        ["of which it stands", share(standingShare(how, one, cage, cage, depth)), ""],
+        ["winds an hour", places(windsAnHour(worked, depth), 2), ""],
+        ["it raises", perHour(raises(how, one, decks, depth, allowed, aTub)), ""],
+        ["and in a day", perDay(raisesADay(how, one, decks, depth, allowed, hours, aTub)), ""],
+        [`standing, in a ${places(hours, 0)} hour day`, `${places(standingADay(how, one, cage, cage, depth, hours), 2)} h`, ""],
+      ],
+    ),
+    "",
+    ...heading("deck by deck"),
+    ...table(
+      [right("decks"), right("payload"), right("stand"), right("cycle"), right("raises")],
+      deckSheet(how, one, depth, allowed, most, aTub).map((each) => [
+        places(each.decks, 0),
+        tonnes(each.payload),
+        seconds(each.stand),
+        seconds(each.cycle),
+        perHour(each.raises),
+      ]),
+    ),
+    "",
+    line("a deck more than the one asked for is worth", `${signed(worthOfADeck(how, one, decks, depth, allowed, aTub), 2)} t/h`),
+    line("the decking that raises most is", `${places(bestDecks(how, one, depth, allowed, most, aTub), 0)} decks`),
+    line("a full deck holds", tonnes(deckPayload(one, 1, aTub))),
+  ];
+
+  if (allowed !== undefined) {
+    out.push(line(`on an allowance of ${force(allowed)} the rope fills`, `${places(decksAllowed(one, allowed, aTub), 0)} decks`));
+  }
+
+  return out;
+}

diff --git a/src/cycle/decking.ts b/src/cycle/decking.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7e2beaa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cycle/decking.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,410 @@
+/**
+ * The standing time, worked out instead of guessed at.
+ *
+ * `profile` takes the standing time as a figure somebody has typed in,
+ * and in a shallow shaft that figure is the largest item in the cycle.
+ * It is also the one item that has nothing to do with the winder: it is
+ * the time the cage stands on the keps at the pit top and the pit
+ * bottom while full tubs are pushed off it and empty ones pushed on,
+ * and a two-deck cage stands twice, because the deck the winder is not
+ * looking at has to be brought level with the landing first.
+ *
+ * So the standing time is a landing's arithmetic and not a machine's:
+ * so many seconds a tub, so many tubs a deck, and a short creep between
+ * decks at whatever speed the winder is allowed to inch at. A skip
+ * simply opens its bottom, takes the same dozen seconds however deep
+ * the shaft is, and does not care how many decks anybody imagines it
+ * has. A counterweight stands for no time whatever, which is one of the
+ * things in its favour.
+ *
+ * The two landings are worked at the same time, so the winder waits for
+ * the slower of them and not for both — which is why a pit bottom that
+ * decks in eighteen seconds costs nothing at all while the pit top
+ * takes twenty-four, and everything the moment it takes twenty-five.
+ */
+
+import { count, insist, nonNegative, positive, within } from "../errors.ts";
+import { round } from "../units/round.ts";
+import { weightOf } from "../units/measure.ts";
+import {
+  A_TUB,
+  CAGE_TARE,
+  type Conveyance,
+  conveyance,
+  loadedWeight,
+  payloadAllowed,
+} from "../cage/conveyance.ts";
+import { type Profile, cycleTime, profile, tonnesADay, tonnesAnHour, windsAnHour } from "./kinematics.ts";
+
+/** How a landing is worked. */
+export interface Decking {
+  /** How long one tub takes to change, in seconds. */
+  readonly perTub: number;
+  /** How many tubs stand on a deck. */
+  readonly tubsADeck: number;
+  /** How far apart the decks are, in metres. */
+  readonly pitch: number;
+  /** How long it takes to set the cage on the keps again, in seconds. */
+  readonly settle: number;
+  /** How long a skip takes to discharge, in seconds. */
+  readonly discharge: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A decking arrangement, checked.
+ *
+ * A deck holds a whole number of tubs above nought. Half a tub is not a
+ * quantity a landing has ever handled, and a deck that holds none is a
+ * cage nobody would have built.
+ */
+export function decking(over: Partial<Decking> = {}): Decking {
+  const found: Decking = {
+    perTub: over.perTub ?? A_TUB_TAKES,
+    tubsADeck: over.tubsADeck ?? TUBS_A_DECK,
+    pitch: over.pitch ?? DECK_PITCH,
+    settle: over.settle ?? KEPS_TAKE,
+    discharge: over.discharge ?? A_SKIP_DISCHARGES,
+  };
+  positive(found.perTub, "perTub");
+  count(found.tubsADeck, "tubsADeck");
+  positive(found.tubsADeck, "tubsADeck");
+  positive(found.pitch, "pitch");
+  nonNegative(found.settle, "settle");
+  nonNegative(found.discharge, "discharge");
+  return found;
+}
+
+/** How long a tub takes to change, in seconds. */
+export const A_TUB_TAKES = 6;
+
+/** How many tubs a deck is built to hold. */
+export const TUBS_A_DECK = 2;
+
+/** How far apart a cage's decks are, in metres. */
+export const DECK_PITCH = 2.4;
+
+/** How long the keps take, each time the cage is set on them, in seconds. */
+export const KEPS_TAKE = 4;
+
+/** How long a skip takes to discharge through its own bottom, in seconds. */
+export const A_SKIP_DISCHARGES = 12;
+
+/** The most decks a cage is built with. */
+export const MOST_DECKS = 6;
+
+/** How long one deck's tubs take to change, in seconds. */
+export function deckChange(one: Decking): number {
+  return round(one.tubsADeck * one.perTub, 3);
+}
+
+/**
+ * How long it takes to bring the next deck to the landing, in seconds.
+ *
+ * The deck pitch at creep speed and then the keps again. It is done by
+ * the winder but it is not part of the wind: the cage is at the landing
+ * throughout and the rope is doing nothing else.
+ */
+export function deckMove(one: Decking, creep = 0.5): number {
+  positive(creep, "creep");
+  return round(one.pitch / creep + one.settle, 3);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The moves a cage of so many decks wants, in seconds.
+ *
+ * One move for every deck after the first, because the deck the cage
+ * arrives with is already at the landing.
+ */
+export function redecking(one: Decking, decks: number, creep = 0.5): number {
+  count(decks, "decks");
+  positive(decks, "decks");
+  return round((decks - 1) * deckMove(one, creep), 3);
+}
+
+/**
+ * How long one conveyance stands at its landing, in seconds.
+ *
+ * A cage stands for its decks and for the moves between them. A skip
+ * stands for its discharge, however many decks it is written down as
+ * having, because it has none. A counterweight stands for nothing.
+ */
+export function standAt(one: Decking, what: Conveyance, creep = 0.5): number {
+  if (what.kind === "counterweight") return 0;
+  if (what.kind === "skip") return round(one.discharge, 3);
+  return round(what.decks * deckChange(one) + redecking(one, what.decks, creep), 3);
+}
+
+/**
+ * How long the winder stands between winds, in seconds.
+ *
+ * The slower of the two landings and not the sum of them: the pit top
+ * and the pit bottom are worked at the same time by different men, so
+ * the winder waits for whichever of them finishes last.
+ */
+export function stand(one: Decking, rising: Conveyance, falling: Conveyance, creep = 0.5): number {
+  return round(Math.max(standAt(one, rising, creep), standAt(one, falling, creep)), 3);
+}
+
+/** A profile with the standing time worked out rather than typed in. */
+export function withDecking(how: Profile, one: Decking, rising: Conveyance, falling: Conveyance): Profile {
+  return profile({ ...how, rest: stand(one, rising, falling, how.creep) });
+}
+
+/** What share of the cycle that standing time is. */
+export function standingShare(
+  how: Profile,
+  one: Decking,
+  rising: Conveyance,
+  falling: Conveyance,
+  wind: number,
+): number {
+  const worked = withDecking(how, one, rising, falling);
+  const whole = cycleTime(worked, wind);
+  insist(whole > 0, "that cycle takes no time at all", "wind");
+  return round(worked.rest / whole, 4);
+}
+
+/**
+ * How long the winder stands in a working day, in hours.
+ *
+ * The figure to put in front of anybody who wants a faster winder for a
+ * shallow shaft. It is not a fraction of a cycle, which sounds small;
+ * it is hours a day of a machine standing still with men on both
+ * landings, which does not.
+ */
+export function standingADay(
+  how: Profile,
+  one: Decking,
+  rising: Conveyance,
+  falling: Conveyance,
+  wind: number,
+  hours = 16,
+): number {
+  within(hours, 0, 24, "hours");
+  const worked = withDecking(how, one, rising, falling);
+  return round((windsAnHour(worked, wind) * hours * worked.rest) / 3600, 3);
+}
+
+/** The coal a cage of so many decks holds, in kilograms. */
+export function deckPayload(one: Decking, decks: number, aTub = A_TUB): number {
+  count(decks, "decks");
+  within(decks, 1, MOST_DECKS, "decks");
+  positive(aTub, "aTub");
+  return round(decks * one.tubsADeck * aTub, 3);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Whether a rope allowance will lift an empty cage of so many decks.
+ *
+ * Asked first, because a cage the rope will not lift empty is not a
+ * cage that can be filled to anything at all, and the arithmetic that
+ * walks up the decks has to know where to stop.
+ */
+export function deckedCarries(one: Decking, decks: number, allowed?: number, aTub = A_TUB): boolean {
+  if (allowed === undefined) return true;
+  positive(allowed, "allowed");
+  return weightOf(round(deckPayload(one, decks, aTub) * CAGE_TARE, 0)) < allowed;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A cage of so many decks, tared at the cage ratio on the coal it holds.
+ *
+ * A deck added to a cage adds its own steel as well as its coal, and
+ * the cage ratio is the trade's way of saying so: two tonnes of cage
+ * for every tonne it carries. Where a rope allowance is given and the
+ * lot is more than the rope stands, the cage is filled to what the rope
+ * allows instead — a cage that cannot be filled is still a cage, and it
+ * is the arithmetic that says how many decks are worth building.
+ */
+export function deckedCage(one: Decking, decks: number, allowed?: number, aTub = A_TUB): Conveyance {
+  const coal = deckPayload(one, decks, aTub);
+  const full = conveyance({
+    name: `a ${decks}-deck cage`,
+    kind: "cage",
+    tare: round(coal * CAGE_TARE, 0),
+    payload: coal,
+    decks,
+  });
+  if (allowed === undefined) return full;
+  positive(allowed, "allowed");
+  if (loadedWeight(full) <= allowed) return full;
+  insist(
+    deckedCarries(one, decks, allowed, aTub),
+    `that rope will not lift an empty cage of ${decks} decks, let alone the coal on them`,
+    "allowed",
+  );
+  return conveyance({ ...full, payload: payloadAllowed(full, allowed) });
+}
+
+/**
+ * The most decks a rope will fill, of the six a cage is built with.
+ *
+ * Filled, not merely lifted: a seventh deck that has to be run
+ * half-empty raises no more coal than a sixth that is full, and the
+ * cage ratio means every deck brings twice its own coal in steel. So
+ * this counts the decks the rope carries loaded, and gives nought where
+ * it will not carry even one.
+ */
+export function decksAllowed(one: Decking, allowed: number, aTub = A_TUB): number {
+  positive(allowed, "allowed");
+  let found = 0;
+  for (let at = 1; at <= MOST_DECKS; at += 1) {
+    const coal = deckPayload(one, at, aTub);
+    if (weightOf(round(coal * CAGE_TARE, 0) + coal) <= allowed) found = at;
+  }
+  return found;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What a cage of so many decks raises, in tonnes an hour.
+ *
+ * Nought where the rope allowance leaves no coal at all, because a cage
+ * that is all steel raises no coal — and a deck that turns a cage into
+ * that is a deck worth knowing the price of.
+ */
+export function raises(
+  how: Profile,
+  one: Decking,
+  decks: number,
+  wind: number,
+  allowed?: number,
+  aTub = A_TUB,
+): number {
+  const cage = deckedCage(one, decks, allowed, aTub);
+  if (cage.payload <= 0) return 0;
+  return tonnesAnHour(withDecking(how, one, cage, cage), wind, cage.payload);
+}
+
+/** And in a working day. */
+export function raisesADay(
+  how: Profile,
+  one: Decking,
+  decks: number,
+  wind: number,
+  allowed?: number,
+  hours = 16,
+  aTub = A_TUB,
+): number {
+  const cage = deckedCage(one, decks, allowed, aTub);
+  if (cage.payload <= 0) {
+    within(hours, 0, 24, "hours");
+    return 0;
+  }
+  return tonnesADay(withDecking(how, one, cage, cage), wind, cage.payload, hours);
+}
+
+/**
+ * What one more deck is worth, in tonnes an hour.
+ *
+ * It is not what anybody expects. A deck adds its coal to every wind,
+ * but it also adds a deck-change and a move to every standing time, so
+ * the figure falls with every deck; and where the rope is the limit the
+ * deck adds its steel and no coal at all, so the figure goes through
+ * nought and a cage with fewer decks in it raises more than one with
+ * more.
+ */
+export function worthOfADeck(
+  how: Profile,
+  one: Decking,
+  decks: number,
+  wind: number,
+  allowed?: number,
+  aTub = A_TUB,
+): number {
+  count(decks, "decks");
+  within(decks, 1, MOST_DECKS, "decks");
+  if (decks >= MOST_DECKS) return 0;
+  const now = raises(how, one, decks, wind, allowed, aTub);
+  const more = raises(how, one, decks + 1, wind, allowed, aTub);
+  return round(more - now, 4);
+}
+
+/**
+ * The number of decks that raises the most coal.
+ *
+ * Not the most decks that will go in a cage, and not the most a rope
+ * will lift: the most that raises coal, which where the rope is the
+ * limit is fewer than either.
+ */
+export function bestDecks(
+  how: Profile,
+  one: Decking,
+  wind: number,
+  allowed?: number,
+  most = MOST_DECKS,
+  aTub = A_TUB,
+): number {
+  count(most, "most");
+  within(most, 1, MOST_DECKS, "most");
+  let best = 0;
+  let raised = 0;
+  for (let at = 1; at <= most; at += 1) {
+    if (!deckedCarries(one, at, allowed, aTub)) continue;
+    if (deckedCage(one, at, allowed, aTub).payload <= 0) continue;
+    const found = raises(how, one, at, wind, allowed, aTub);
+    if (best === 0 || found > raised) {
+      best = at;
+      raised = found;
+    }
+  }
+  insist(best > 0, "that rope will not carry a cage of any decking at all", "allowed");
+  return best;
+}
+
+/** One line of a decking sheet: a number of decks and what it does. */
+export interface DeckLine {
+  /** How many decks the cage has. */
+  readonly decks: number;
+  /** What it carries, in kilograms. */
+  readonly payload: number;
+  /** How long it stands, in seconds. */
+  readonly stand: number;
+  /** How long the whole cycle takes, in seconds. */
+  readonly cycle: number;
+  /** What it raises, in tonnes an hour. */
+  readonly raises: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * A row for every number of decks, up to the most a cage is built with.
+ *
+ * The sheet the argument is settled on. The payload rises with the
+ * decks, the standing time rises with them too, and the cycle they are
+ * both in decides which of the two wins — which is a different answer
+ * in a shallow shaft than in a deep one.
+ */
+export function deckSheet(
+  how: Profile,
+  one: Decking,
+  wind: number,
+  allowed?: number,
+  most = MOST_DECKS,
+  aTub = A_TUB,
+): DeckLine[] {
+  count(most, "most");
+  within(most, 1, MOST_DECKS, "most");
+  const out: DeckLine[] = [];
+  for (let at = 1; at <= most; at += 1) {
+    if (!deckedCarries(one, at, allowed, aTub)) continue;
+    const cage = deckedCage(one, at, allowed, aTub);
+    if (cage.payload <= 0) continue;
+    const worked = withDecking(how, one, cage, cage);
+    out.push({
+      decks: at,
+      payload: cage.payload,
+      stand: worked.rest,
+      cycle: cycleTime(worked, wind),
+      raises: tonnesAnHour(worked, wind, cage.payload),
+    });
+  }
+  insist(out.length > 0, "that rope will not carry a cage of any decking at all", "allowed");
+  return out;
+}
+
+/** The decking described in a line. */
+export function describeDecking(one: Decking, creep = 0.5): string {
+  return (
+    `${one.tubsADeck} tubs a deck at ${round(one.perTub, 1)} s each is ${round(deckChange(one), 1)} s a deck, ` +
+    `and a deck move is ${round(deckMove(one, creep), 1)} s`
+  );
+}
